# Provenance

This source tree was reconstructed with ILSpy from the exact managed DLL
embedded in `DF-AMP.dfmod` from `MASTER_DFAMP_09G_07_OCT_2026.zip`.

Embedded DLL size: **35,840 bytes**

Embedded DLL SHA-256:

`01dd2d8df9900b8a4fe54ceb0698bd1ad00966e8e30fe11fccdc6803e7d7734a`

Important: the validated `.dfmod` stores a compiled .NET assembly rather
than the original C# text. The files in this directory are therefore an
editable decompilation of the exact PASS binary, not the author's original
source text.

Pristine upstream Dynamic Music source is preserved separately under
`upstream/DynamicMusic/`.

Extended project credit: **DF-AMP PLAYER BY RICO**.
